item.title: Overview of Biometric Access Control Solutions
item.description:
Advanced Biometric Access Control Devices
#

Chiyu Technology offers a comprehensive selection of biometric controllers, tailored for modern access control requirements. These devices integrate fingerprint and facial recognition technologies to deliver secure, standalone solutions suitable for various environments.

Chiyu Technology offers a diverse portfolio of access control products, combining advanced hardware and robust software to address the evolving needs of security and facility management. item.title: Advanced Access Control Reader Solutions for Modern Security
item.description:
Advanced Access Control Reader Solutions for Modern Security
#

Chiyu Technology offers a comprehensive range of Wiegand/OSDP readers, engineered to deliver secure and efficient access control for various environments. These readers support both traditional and advanced authentication methods, ensuring compatibility and flexibility for system integrators and end-users alike.
